extra.message: Session Cookie Missing Secure Flag — An attacker can capture the session token over unencrypted HTTP and hijack any active user session, gaining full access to that user's account and associated data. [verified: The code explicitly sets `secure=False` on the session cookie (line 36) with no compensating control—no HSTS header, no runtime check for HTTPS, and no config overrides for the Secure flag. An attacker on an unencrypted network or via MITM can intercept the cookie and hijack any active session.]
